# AMC Segmented Glass

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**List Template** for Universal Theme · direction: depth · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A frosted-glass segmented control for page navigation: a recessed glass tray with a raised glass thumb that sits on the current page and glides to the segment under the pointer or keyboard focus, driven by CSS :has() alone.

**Use it for:** Two to eight sibling pages or views on a List region: switching a page between Board, List and Calendar views, or between Orders, Invoices and Customers. One level; sub entries are ignored.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_segmented_glass.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/list-templates/amc-segmented-glass.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

Create or pick a List (Shared Components > Lists), add a **List** region and set **Appearance > List Template** to **AMC Segmented Glass**. In APEXlang: `componentAppearance { listTemplate: @amc-segmented-glass }`.

List template for view switching and page-level navigation. Each entry is a real link with icon and label; the current entry gets aria-current=page. Segments share one width, and a raised glass thumb marks the current page and slides to the hovered or keyboard-focused segment without JavaScript. Lists longer than eight entries, and browsers without :has(), keep a static glass thumb on the current segment. The control scrolls horizontally when it is wider than its container. Template options: Icon only hides the labels visually, keeps them for screen readers and shows them as a tooltip on hover and focus; Stacked puts the icon above the label; Primary thumb fills the thumb with the primary color; Stretch spans the full width; Large raises the height. Under prefers-reduced-motion the thumb jumps without sliding; in forced-colors mode the current segment gets a system outline.

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Icon only | `amc-TSegmentedGlass--iconOnly` | Shows only icons; the label stays available to screen readers and appears as a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus. Every entry needs an icon. |
| Stacked icon and label | `amc-TSegmentedGlass--stacked` | Places the icon above a smaller label, like an app tab bar. |
| Primary thumb | `amc-TSegmentedGlass--primary` | The glass thumb takes the primary color and the segment on it switches to the primary contrast color. |
| Stretch | `amc-TSegmentedGlass--stretch` | The control spans the full width of the region with equal segments. |
| Large | `amc-TSegmentedGlass--large` | Taller segments with larger text and icons, for page headers and touch screens. |
